title: Calling `notify_property_list_changed` collapses object properties in Array of custom Ressources
body:
### Tested versions

Reproductible in v4.5.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045)

### Issue description

I'm trying to write a tool script that has an array of custom ressources whose contents will dynamically update enum options for other objects. 
To do that, my understanding is that the best approach is to have each object signal it has changed when its properties are modified, and then to recalculate the enum options using `notify_property_list_changed()`. 
However, while that approach works, every time `notify_property_list_changed()` is called, object's properties in the array get collapsed in the editor, meaning I can only change the properties 1 character at a time. 
This is obviously a huge hassle and I feel the editor should maintain the displayed state of the array of objects when updating. 

### Steps to reproduce

in the MRP: 
- Select the Node
- Expand the Array Of Custom
- Add an element
- Expand the element's properties
- Try to enter "test" in the `variable` field

You will notice although the select options follow your lead, every time you type a letter, the object collapses on you

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22901767/mrp.zip)
